meta.title: Forward auction: bid for less than the auction quantity

steps.note: Open the prepared live forward auction without recreating or changing its state.
Move to Vendor A's supplier-portal session while leaving the buyer session available.
Open the live auction's vendor bid sheet.
Enter the default bid price without submitting so the invalid quantity can be set first.
Set the offered quantity to 6, below the auction quantity of 10.

args.because: Offer Quantity should be equal to the Auction Quantity

steps.note: Submit the under-quantity bid and require Procol to refuse it with the expected validation message.
